clayresearch.delta: Fuse FRANK whole-system multiscale recurrence with semantic coupling, GWT/emergence control and staged build. Search minimal typed controller/readout basis and compare recurrent-control explanations against conventional event-driven alternatives.
clayresearch.required_next_test: Cross-domain synthesis that preserves counterhypotheses and identifies which control primitives are genuinely shared versus loop-family-specific.

frank.delta: Treat the whole organism as candidate loop-of-loops; enumerate loop families, timescales, state/update/coupling/intervention surfaces and test historical regulators as causal controllers rather than decorative neuro labels.
frank.required_next_test: Ubuntu H1 typed loop inventory plus regulator lesion/rescue plan; no direct FRANK self-harness mutation.

gwt.delta: Test GWT ignition/focus as adaptive recurrent-compute admission/continuation routing while keeping selection, emergence and stability distinct.
gwt.required_next_test: Fixed recurrence budget versus outcome-gated adaptive continue/exit routing with matched episodes.

emergenz.delta: Add whole-system loop dynamics/stability readouts to causal-emergence experiments; recurrence alone remains non-evidence.
emergenz.required_next_test: Classify converging/productive-cycle/stalled/diverging regimes and combine with lesion/rescue, shuffled re-entry and cross-timescale controls.

claycode.delta: Represent recurrent state/timescale/budget/halt/dynamics/intervention/rollback semantics in executable typed IR; prefer implementation over language redesign.
claycode.required_next_test: Compile a minimal LoopDynamicsReadout + controller/intervention contract through parser -> typed IR -> type/effect -> runtime on Ubuntu.

hyperposition.delta: Test preserved alternatives as bounded anti-stagnation/attractor-escape mechanism and represent competing recurrent routes/timescales without destructive collapse.
hyperposition.required_next_test: Matched stalled episodes with branch reopening versus no reopening, measuring recovery and destabilization risk.

claygraph.delta: Project typed loop/coupling topology, timescales, gain/delay/inhibition and intervention handles as derived epoch-bound graph state without truth promotion.
claygraph.required_next_test: Dynamic loop graph on H1 traces plus topology lesion/rescue and stale-edge controls.

unifieddb.delta: Persist loop-state time series, epochs, recurrence budgets, pressures, interventions, readouts, outcomes, causal credit and checkpoints for deterministic replay without assuming physical monolithic storage.
unifieddb.required_next_test: Replay/query contract for time-aligned loop dynamics and intervention comparisons with snapshot consistency.

harness.delta: Execute the discriminating loop-of-loops experiment on Ubuntu: instrument, perturb, classify, lesion, rescue and compare fixed/adaptive recurrence.
harness.required_next_test: H1 frozen replay with finite-difference coupling/Jacobian proxies and regulator lesions; H2 differential semantic parity afterward.

global_controls: Android/mobile/edge out of FRANK v0.1 scope
